name: Kuantan
ai_name: Kuantan town centre, Pahang, Malaysia, beside Sungai Kuantan

notes.businesses: Shops, eateries and pharmacies as mapped on OpenStreetMap (fetched 3 Oct 2026). The list is what volunteers have mapped, not checked on the ground, so many real businesses are missing and some listed ones may have closed.
notes.shelters: No relief centre list from an official or public source has been collected for this area, so none are shown.
notes.history: Dated floods that sources say reached this town centre, from news and official reports checked on 3 Oct 2026 (details and every source opened: the project's raw-data notes). Not a complete record.
notes.depths: Depth check: the model puts more than 5 m of water at 19 of these businesses in a 1 in 100 years flood, but news reports of real floods in the town give up to about 1.5 m. Read the model's depths as the model's, not as what to expect.

floods.what: Flash floods covered town-centre roads, including Jalan Tun Ismail, Jalan Mahkota and Jalan Bukit Ubi, and some shops and shopping centres closed. Road depth was reported as 1.5 m, and about 1 m at 14 junctions.
Roads in and around the town were under up to 1 m of water, and most shops and banks closed after power cuts.
floods.source: Bernama via Malay Mail, 4 Dec 2013; mStar, 3 Dec 2013

floods.what: Water rose up to 0.5 m on parts of Jalan Tun Ismail and Jalan Bukit Ubi after two hours of heavy rain.
City-centre roads flooded, about 0.5 m on some stretches, including Jalan Bukit Ubi and Jalan Lim Hoe Lek.
floods.source: Berita Harian, 3 Jan 2021; New Straits Times, 3 Jan 2021

floods.what: Town-centre roads flooded to about 0.5 m, and the wet market on Jalan Tun Ismail had ankle-deep water.
